# AROME-PI gateway answer

`shortterm-2026-11-18.json` is a real answer of the vigie-meteo gateway (`GET /v1/shortterm?lat=50.63&lon=3.06`, Lille), served on
2026-11-18 at about 09:35 UTC from the run of 08:00 UTC that the gateway had downloaded from Météo-France's `aromepi/1.0` WCS. The 18
steps that were not yet past are kept as they came (gusts up to 74 km/h, rain). Nothing was edited by hand.
